title: English Practice Quiz 0759
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.
